prompt: A farmers market stall booking app where organizers assign stalls and vendors can only see their own booking.
A music school lesson scheduler where teachers set their availability and only the registrar can cancel a booked lesson.
A bicycle courier dispatch board where couriers see only the deliveries assigned to them and dispatchers see every job.
A community garden plot allocation tool where gardeners request plots and only the committee can approve or revoke one.
An auto repair estimate approval app where customers approve estimates and only service advisors can change the line items.
A hotel housekeeping task board where housekeepers see only their assigned floor and supervisors see every floor.
A nonprofit grant application tracker where applicants see their own submission status and reviewers can see all applications.
A church volunteer signup sheet where anyone can sign up for a slot but only coordinators can remove someone from one.
A fishing charter booking site where captains manage their own trips and only the harbor office can issue a refund.
A museum docent tour scheduler where docents claim open tours and only curators can publish the final schedule.
A pet grooming appointment book where groomers see their own appointments and only the shop owner sees revenue totals.
A bakery custom cake order form where customers submit requests and only bakers can change an order status.
A cleaning service route planner where cleaners see only their own route and managers can reassign any stop.
A tutoring center progress report tool where tutors write reports and only the parents of that student can read them.
An escape room booking page where groups pick a time slot and pay a deposit.
A home inventory app for insurance records that tracks belongings, receipts, and photos for one household.
A drone flight log where pilots record each flight and only the compliance officer can mark a log reviewed.
A youth soccer league roster app where coaches see only their own team and the league administrator sees every team.
A vinyl record collection tracker where a collector catalogs albums and rates them, no accounts needed.
A clinical trial participant scheduler where coordinators book visits and only the principal investigator can unblind an assignment.
